scientific_integrity: Proof is reconstructed from elementary run-interval decomposition. Independent finite literal computation reproduces predictions for 2,537 parameter cases; external independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Assumes at least two distinct letters and each letter occurs in exactly one run per period, all run lengths positive, two shifts both smaller than the primitive period; does not classify repeated-letter runs or larger shift sets. Exact theorem is proved without appealing to finite enumeration. Originality has residual risk of unlocated exact specialization.
title: Exact delay and defect spectra for two-shift pseudoperiods of distinct-run cyclic words
